plan_item: 77.44.7.D / D-06 — Editor media library and authored video poster asset lifecycle

details: Extended the integrated test with an independent, active synthetic PNG media row and in-memory R2 object. This avoids reusing an image fixture whose object was deliberately removed by the preceding missing-object audit scenario.

Exercised the actual Inspector's video poster image picker; checked that video media is excluded; selecting a poster only changes local editor state and previews from the authenticated private Worker route.

Checked that Save persists posterAssetId and draft usage while the public route remains 404; Editor reload restores the exact private image bytes, accessible selected-image label, and private poster URL.

Checked that only the separate Publish makes the image route public, preserves image/png and exact bytes, switches the public video poster to /media/{id}, and records published usage. Audio/video playback regression checks continue to pass in the same end-to-end case.

Two earlier focused runs exposed test setup issues (an incorrect selected-image attribute expectation and reuse of the intentionally missing R2 fixture). Both were corrected; the final complete run passed. These were test-fixture problems, not production data or runtime failures.
